_about: 乗換便利号車 (目安). Every entry must come from a public source recorded in "source".
Directions use the app's lines.json order: forward = stations[0] -> stations[1].
tokyo.yamanote: forward = 内回り (東京->神田->上野), reverse = 外回り. 11 cars, 1号車 is the 外回り front.
Door numbers are as printed on the platform (Yamanote: door 1 is the end of each car nearest 1号車).
frontCar = car number at the front of the train in that direction; door1AtFront = door 1 is the front door of each car in that direction.
to = transfer line id (optional toForward = direction of the next line), or "exit:<gate name>". First exit listed = shown by default.
Never guess: leave a station out if no source states the car/door for that line and direction.
